Pẽgr be ne Wẽnde, sẽn yɑɑ sɑɑs lɑ Tẽng Naandã, sẽn kɩta tɩ Malεgsã yaa tẽn-tʋmdb sẽn tɑr pɩgs ɑ yiib-yiib lɑ tãɑb-tãɑb lɑ nɑɑs-nɑɑse, A pɑɑsdɑ A sẽn dɑt nɑɑnegã pʋgẽ, ad A yɑɑ bũmb fãɑ Tõodɑ.
Wẽnd sẽn pɑkd sẽn yi A yolsgẽ wã n kõ nebã, gɩdgd kae ye; A sẽn mong me, kõt kɑ be ɑ loogr poor ye, lɑ Yẽ lɑ Zɩsg lɑ bʋʋd minim Soaba.
Yaa yãmb nebɑ! Tẽeg-y Wẽnd neema wã A sẽn kõ yãmbã; rẽ yĩngɑ nɑɑnd zẽng sẽn kɑ Wẽnd n dɩlgd yãmb tɩ yit sɑɑsẽ wã lɑ Tẽngã? Soɑb sẽn tũud kɑe rẽndɑ Yẽ. Yɑɑ wãn tɩ b tɑr yãmb n tɑt n teesdẽ?
Lɑ b sã n yɑgs foom, sɩd la hakɩɩka, b rag n yɑgsɑ tẽn-tʋmdb sẽn deng foom tɑoore, lɑ Wẽnd nengẽ lɑ yεlã fãa lebgr zĩigɑ.
Yaa yãmb nebɑ! Ad Wẽnd pʋlengã yɑɑ sɩda, bɩ y rɑ bɑs tɩ dũni wã vɩɩm belg yãmb n tõog ye, lɑ y rɑ wɑ sɑk tɩ bεlgdã me wɑ belg yãmb n tõog ye.
Ad Sʋɩtãanã yɑɑ bε yãmb yĩngɑ, bɩ y rɩk-ɑ n mɑɑn y bε, ad a boondɑ a sullã bʋɩl yĩng lɑ b nɑ nɑɑg Bugum rãmbẽ wã bɑlɑ.
Neb nins sẽn kɩllã naong-kεgeng be b yĩngɑ, lɑ neb nins sẽn kõ-b sɩd lɑ b tʋm tʋʋm-sõama wã, yaafg lɑ keoor sẽn bεdem be b yĩngɑ.

Rẽ yĩngɑ ned ning b sẽn nɑgs ɑ tʋʋm-wẽng n kõ-ɑ t'ɑ ne-ɑ tɩ yɑɑ sõma, yẽ soab ne tʋʋm-sõɑmɑ soɑb yaa wala tɑɑba? Ad Wẽnd menesd A sẽn dɑt ɑ soɑb lɑ A kãndg A sẽn dɑt ɑ soɑba, bɩ f rɑ wɑ sãam f sũur b yĩng ye, ad Wẽnd mii b sẽn maandã.
Lɑ Wẽnd lɑ sẽn tʋmd sebdã tɩ b rãmbd sɑwɑt tɩ Tõnd peegd-b n kẽngd tẽn-koεεngẽ n tɑll-ɑ n vʋʋg Tẽngã ɑ sẽn ki poore, yɑɑ woto bɑl lɑ kũ-rãmb vʋʋgrã.

Ned ning sẽn yɩ n dɑt zɩslem, ad zɩslemã gill yɑɑ Wẽnd soolem, Yẽ nengẽ lɑ gom-sõma wã rʋʋdɑ; lɑ tʋʋm-sõngo A zẽkd-a-la yĩngri. Lɑ sẽn rɑbsd-b rɑbɑ-wẽnsã, naong sẽn yɑɑ kɛgeng be b yĩngɑ, b raba wã me nɑ n sãɑmɑme n kɑ tɑll yõod ye.

Lɑ Wẽnd naana yãmb ne sẽn yi tomẽ, rẽ poorẽ ne sẽn yi yĩn-koomẽ, rẽ poorẽ t'A mɑɑn yãmb yiib-yiibu, rɑo lɑ paga, lɑ pɑg kɑ be sẽn nɑ n rɩk pʋgɑ, bɩ ɑ rogdame, rẽndɑme t'A mii tiiri. Bõn-nɑɑndg kɑ be sẽn nɑ vɩɩm n pɑɑs bɑɑ bilfu, bɩ a vɩɩmã booge, rẽndɑme tɩ rɑ gʋlsɑ sebr pʋgẽ. Ad rẽndɑ yɑɑ nɑɑnɑ wʋsg ne Wẽnde.

Lɑ moɑg ɑ yiibã ka wõnd taab ye, yãoã (koomã yaa noogo, n sakd yũubu, t'a to wã (koom) yaa yɑmsem bɑgɑ. Yãmb rɩtɑ nem-bʋgs sẽn yit b yiibã fãa pʋgẽ, lɑ y yiisd nɑgem-teoog n yeelgdẽ; tɩ fo yãt kogl-bεdã tɩ b wedgd n teesdẽ, bʋɩl yĩng lɑ yãmb bɑo sẽn yi Wẽnd yɩɩdlemã, tɩ sãnd-sãnde yãmb nɑ pẽge.

A kẽesdɑ yʋng wĩndg pʋgẽ lɑ A kẽesd wĩndg yʋng pʋgẽ, lɑ A nom wĩntoogã lɑ kiuugã tɩ yembr fãɑ zoet n nɑ n tãɑg sɑsɑ sẽn yãk tɩ beẽ. Yẽ lɑ Wẽnd sẽn yɑɑ yãmb Soɑbã, nɑɑmã yɑɑ Yẽ n so, lɑ yãmb sẽn boond-b rãmb zẽng sẽn kɑ Yẽ wã kɑ so bɑɑ zũuf wʋʋg meng ye.
Yãmb sã n bõosd-b me, b kɑ wʋmd yãmb ye, b sã n dɑ wʋm me, b kɑ nɑ n deeg yãmb yĩng ye. Yikrã rɑɑrã b nɑ n kɩɩsɑ yãmb lɑgem-n-tɑɑrã b yĩngã. La kõn n kõ foom kiba-tɩrga wala kiba-Mit ye.
Yãmb ɑ nebã! Yãmb lɑ tʋlsem dãmb ne Wẽnde, lɑ Wẽnde, Yẽ lɑ Sek-m-meng Soɑb n yɑɑ pẽgr Naaba.
A sã n dɑtɑ A loogdɑ ne yãmb lɑ A wɑ ne bõn-nɑɑnds pɑɑlɑ.
Woto pa yɩ n yaa toog ne Wẽnd ye.

Lɑ bõn-nɑɑdg kɑ tʋkd bõn-nɑɑndg tɑɑg yel-wẽng ye, lɑ yel-wẽnd soɑb sã n bool tɩ b sõng-a n tʋke, b kɑ sõngd-a n tʋk bũmb ye, bɑɑ tɩ yɑɑ rog-pẽta. Ad fo sẽn bugsdã yɑɑ neb nins sẽn yεεsd b Soɑbã baa ne b sẽn ka yã-A wã la b yalsd Pʋʋsgã. Sẽn yɩlgdɑ a menga, ɑ tʋmɑ a meng yĩng bɑlɑ, lɑ yɑɑ Wẽnd nengẽ lɑ lebgrã zĩigɑ.
Lɑ zoɑng ne nin soɑb kɑ yɑa wɑ tɑɑb ye.
Lɑ ligs lɑ vẽenem me kɑ yɑa wɑ tɑɑb ye.
Lɑ mɑɑsem ne pems tʋʋlg me kɑ yɑa wɑ tɑɑb ye.
Lɑ vɩtb lɑ kɩɩms kɑ yɑa wɑ tɑɑb ye, ad Wẽnd wʋmsdɑ A sẽn dɑt soɑbɑ, lɑ fo kɑ tõe tɩ sẽn be-b yɑɑdẽ wã wʋm ye.
Fo kɑ yɩ, rẽndɑ bugsd bɑlɑ.
Ad Tõnd tʋmɑ foom tɩ f yɑɑ sũ-noɑɑgd lɑ bugsdɑ, lɑ zãma kɑ zĩnd sẽn loog rẽndɑme tɩ bugsd zĩnd b pʋgẽ.
Lɑ b sã n yɑgs foom, sɩd la hakɩɩka, sẽn deng-b bãmb tɑoorã me yɑgsɑme. B tẽn-tʋʋmbã waa b nengẽ ne yel-vẽenese, lɑ sεb toor-toore, lɑ sebr sẽn yɑɑ vẽenem.
Rẽ poorẽ tɩ Tõnd yõk neb nins sẽn kɩfl-bã, lɑ Tõnd sãbsgã yɩɩ wãn-wãna?
Fo kɑ yã tɩ Wẽnd sikɑ koom tɩ yi sɑɑsẽ wã tɩ Tõnd tɑll-ɑ n yiis tɩ-biis kõbg sẽn yõs tɑɑbɑ. Bee tãmsã pʋgẽ, soay sẽn yɑɑ miid lɑ pεεla tɩ b kõbgã yõs tɑɑbɑ, lɑ soɑy sɑblem sẽn tar pãnga.
Lɑ nebã pʋgẽ, lɑ bõn-yãnemdɩ wã, lɑ rũm-mugsã me pʋgẽ, kõbg yõsa tɑɑbɑ me woto. Ad sẽn yεεsd-b Wẽnd A yembsã pʋgẽ, yɑɑ bãngdbã bɑlɑ, ad Wẽnd yɑɑ Zɩsg n yɑɑ Yaafdɑ.
Ad neb nins sẽn kɑremd Wẽnd Sẽbrã lɑ b yɑlsd Pʋʋsgã lɑ b yãkd Tõnd sẽn dɩlg-ba n mɑɑnd neer ne solgr lɑ vẽenegã, b tẽedɑ tolb sẽn kɑ nɑ n bõn ye.
Bʋɩl yĩng lɑ A rol-b b keoorã lɑ A pɑɑs-b sẽn yi A yɩɩdlemẽ wã, ad A yɑɑ Yaafd n yɑɑ bark Pʋʋsd.
Lɑ Tõnd sẽn tũus bũmb ning n sikd fo zug sẽn yi sebrã pʋgẽ wã, yẽ lɑ sɩdã n sɩdgd sẽn deng yẽnda tɑoorã, ɑd Wẽnd yɑɑ kiba-Mitɑ n yɑɑ Netɑ ne A yembsã.

Rẽ poorẽ Tõnd ledsɑ Tõnd sẽn tũus-b rãmb D yembsã pʋgẽ wã sebrẽ wã. Be b pʋgẽ sẽn yɑɑ wẽg-m-meng rãmba, be b pʋgẽ sẽn mɑɑnd tɩ zems soɑb, be b pʋgẽ wã me sẽn yɑɑ põsd ne yel-sõɑmɑ tʋʋmɑ, sẽn tũ ne Wẽnd rɑɑbo, rẽ lɑ yɩɩdlem kẽengã.
Yɑɑ Adan arzãn zɑgsẽ wã la b kẽeda, b yeelgd-b-la zũy sẽn yaa sãnem lɑ lʋ'lʋ' zũyã, lɑ b fut ɑ pʋgẽ yɑɑ Hɑrɩɩre.
Lɑ b yeele: "pẽgr be ne Wẽnde, sẽn loogɑ ne sũ-sãɑngã n bɑs tõndã, ad tõnd Soɑbã yɑɑ Yaafd n yɑɑ Pẽgr Naaba.
Sẽn sikɑ tõnd zĩndg Zakẽ ne A yɩɩdlemã, paab zɑkẽ, yaams kɑ pɑɑmd tõndo, bãɑg me kɑ pɑɑmd-d be.
Lɑ sẽn kɩfl-bã, Gεhɑnnɑm be b yĩngɑ; b pa tolgd n kʋ-b tɩ b ki n pɑɑm n vʋʋse, b leb n kɑ woogd b naongã me. Yɑɑ woto bɑl lɑ Tõnd rond kɩfr buudã fãɑ.

Lɑ bãmb be ɑ pʋgẽ n kɑɑsd n yetẽ: "d Soɑbɑ! Yiis-d tɩ d na tʋm tʋʋm-sõɑmɑ sẽn yõsgd ne tõnd sẽn dɑ yɩ n tʋmdẽ wã" .Rẽ yĩngɑ Tõnd kɑ woglg yãmb yõyã tɩ sek ned ning sẽn dɑt tẽegre, tɩ bugsdã me wɑ yãmb nengẽ? Bɩ y lemd naongã, tɩ sõɑngd kɑ be wẽgdbã yĩng ye.
Ad Wẽnd yaa saas la Tẽng yel-soalem Mita, ad Yẽ yaa Bãngd ne sẽn be sũyẽ wã.
Yẽ lɑ sẽn mɑɑn yãmb tɩ y yɑa lεdsdb Tẽngã zugu, rẽnd sẽn kɩfla, yẽ soɑb kɩflg bee ne-ɑ, lɑ kɩflgã kɑ pɑɑsd-b sã n ka gẽeg b Soɑbã nengẽ, lɑ kɩflgã kɑ pɑɑsd-b rẽndɑ bõne.

Yeele: "yãmb yãa yãmb lɑgem-n-tɑɑs nins yãmb sẽn kot-b rãmb zẽng sẽn kɑ Wẽndã, kõ-y Mɑɑm kibɑr wε? Bõe lɑ b naan Tẽn-gãongã zugu? Bɩ b tɑrɑ lɑgem-n-tɑɑr sɑɑsẽ wã? Bɩ Tõnd kõ-b-lɑ sebr tɩ bãmb tɑr tikr ɑ pʋgẽ, ka woto ye, ad wẽgdbã kɑ pʋlemd tɑɑb rẽndɑ belg-m-meng bɑlɑ.
Ad Wẽnd n gãt saasã lɑ Tẽngã tɩ b kɑ lʋɩtẽ ye. Sã n be lʋɩɩs tɩ b nɑ n lʋɩ, Wẽnd sẽn yãk A toogo, ned a to kɑ be sẽn nɑ n gãd-b ye, ɑd A yɑɑ Tõog-m-meng Soɑbɑ n yɑɑ yɑɑfg Nɑɑbɑ.
Lɑ b wẽen ne b pãngã fãa tεk ne Wẽnd tɩ bugsd sã n da wɑ bãmb nengẽ fãa, b rag n na tẽeg tɩrg n yɩɩd zãma a yembrã; bugsdã sẽn yɑool n wɑ wɑ b nengẽ wã, kɑ pɑɑs-b rẽndɑ zoe-n-lɑk bɑlɑ.

Wɑoog-m-meng maaneg Tẽngã zug lɑ wẽnem rɑbɑ bal yĩngɑ; lɑ wẽnemã rɑbɑ kɑ pɑɑmd rẽndɑ ɑ rãmbã bɑlɑ. Rẽ yĩngɑ bãmbã gũudɑme tɩ kɑ rẽenem dãmbã yellã sẽn bɑɑs to-to wã? Lɑ fo kõn n tol n pɑɑm Wẽnd mɑnesmã teoong ye.

Rẽ yĩngɑ bãmb kɑ nɑ n kẽn Tẽngã zug n ges sẽn deng-b bãmb tɑoorã bɑɑsg sẽn yɩ to-to? Lɑ b rɑ yɩɩdɑ bãmb ne pãng keelem. Wẽnd kɑ yɩ n kong pãng ne bũmb bɑɑ fʋɩ sẽn be sɑɑsẽ bɩ Tẽng zug ye; ad Wẽnd yɩɩme n yɑɑ Bãngd n yaa Tõetɑ.

Lɑ Wẽnd sã n dɑ yõkdẽ nebã ne b sẽn tʋmã, A kõon n bɑsẽ bõn-yãnemdg Tẽngã poor zug ye, lɑ sẽn be bɑlɑ yɑɑ t'A yɑoond-b lɑme n nɑ tãɑg sɑsɑ sẽn yãk tɩ beẽ; tɩ b sɑsɑ wã sã n wɑ tɑ, ad Wẽnd yɩɩme n yɑɑ Net ne A yembsã.
